bib.title: AUTO-RAG: AUTONOMOUS RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED GENERATION FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

read.skipped: C.6/C.7 example outputs and long few-shot prompt bodies skimmed, not read line by line; references skimmed

question: Can an LLM be fine-tuned to decide for itself, by reasoning, when to retrieve and what to query across iterations, instead of using few-shot prompts or hand-written rules?
hypothesis: Reasoning-based autonomous decisions in iterative retrieval, learned from synthesized instructions, outperform rule-based or reflection-token iterative RAG with less inference overhead.
contributions: Auto-RAG: iterative retrieval as multi-turn LLM-retriever dialogue with retrieval planning, information extraction and answer inference reasoning
Automatic synthesis and filtering of reasoning-based iterative retrieval instructions
Results on six benchmarks; adaptive iteration count; natural-language interpretability

method.summary: Llama-3-8B-Instruct synthesizes reasoning chains (few-shot) and Qwen1.5-32B-Chat rewrites queries over NQ and 2Wiki with a retriever in the loop; trajectories are filtered (retrieved docs contain a sub-answer, final answer equals gold) giving 10,000 instructions. Llama-3-8B-Instruct is then SFT'd on them; at inference it loops with the retriever until its output contains a final answer, then falls back to self-generated documents and finally no-retrieval answer.
method.task: open-domain and multi-hop QA with iterative retrieval

datasets.name: Synthesized iterative-retrieval instructions from NQ and 2WikiMultihopQA
datasets.split: inferred: train splits of NQ and 2Wiki (not stated); ~0.5k suffices (Fig 7)
datasets.source: generated by Llama-3-8B-Instruct (reasoning) and Qwen1.5-32B-Chat (queries); T=10 for 2Wiki, 5 for NQ during synthesis
datasets.preprocessing: filter: keep queries whose retrieved docs contain a sub-answer; keep trajectory only if final answer == gold; information need detected by keywords 'however','no information','find','refine'

datasets.name: NQ, TriviaQA, WebQuestions, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA
datasets.split: not stated for main table; 1,000 sampled per dataset (seed 0) for closed-source comparison; 2,000 validation examples sampled to tune docs per iteration; PopQA long-tail subset 1,399 queries for Self-RAG comparison
datasets.source: public benchmarks, following Jin et al. 2024 (FlashRAG)

datasets.name: Wikipedia dump Dec 2018
datasets.source: retrieval corpus (DPR, Karpukhin et al. 2020); Atlas 2018 and 2021 dumps in App A.1

training.objective: SFT cross-entropy over all outputs y_t of the multi-turn dialogue: L = -sum_t log Pr(y_t | x_<=t, y_<t)

other.note: no training hyperparameters beyond epochs are given; Table 10 lists only inference settings

inference.samples: inferred: one run per item (not stated); seed 0 only for 1,000-sample closed-source subset
inference.prompting: zero-shot for fine-tuned model; Naive and Standard RAG prompts in App C.2; few-shot (8-shot adapted from FLARE for 2Wiki) only for data synthesis
inference.retrieval: E5-base-v2 over Wikipedia Dec 2018; docs per iteration NQ 3, 2Wiki 2, TQA 3, PQA 2, HQA 3, WQ 1

parameters.order: external first (T), then self-generated documents (TPK), then no-retrieval answer
parameters.tuning: docs per iteration tuned on 2,000 validation examples (Table 10)

metrics.name: Accuracy
metrics.definition: gold answer appears in final answer (Self-RAG protocol, PopQA long-tail)

eval.protocol: baseline numbers taken from FlashRAG reproduction (Jin et al. 2024) under identical retriever/corpus; no seeds or significance tests reported

prompts.purpose: zero-shot query rewriting for data synthesis

prompts.text: Your task is to generate one corresponding wikipedia document based on the given query to help the LLM answer questions.

Answer the following questions by retrieving external knowledge. Extract useful information from each retrieved document. If the information is insufficient or irrelevant, refine your query and search again until you are able to answer the question:

results.claim: Auto-RAG has the best six-benchmark average of all compared methods, ahead of IRCoT (best baseline) and the iterative-retrieval baselines.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, six benchmarks NQ/2Wiki/TQA/PQA/HQA/WQ; baselines reproduced by FlashRAG (Jin et al. 2024) under identical setup

results.claim: Gain over no-retrieval Naive Gen is largest on PopQA (long-tail) and 2Wiki.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, PopQA

results.claim: Removing training (few-shot prompted base model with the synthesis prompt) lowers the average.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, ablation, base model guided by few-shot prompts
results.table: Table 1/Fig 5, row w/o training, column AVG

results.claim: Removing reasoning (base model answers directly from all docs Auto-RAG retrieved) lowers the average the most, notably 2Wiki F1 26.6 vs 48.9.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, ablation w/o reasoning
results.table: Fig 5, row w/o reasoning, column AVG

results.claim: Using few-shot rather than zero-shot query refinement in data synthesis lowers the average.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, ablation w/o zero-shot refinement
results.table: Fig 5, row w/o zero-shot refinement, column AVG

results.claim: About 0.5k training instructions suffice to acquire autonomous retrieval; more data improves further.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, data scaling 0.1k, 0.5k, 2.5k, 10k on NQ, TriviaQA, HotpotQA
results.quote: approximately 0.5k of data is sufficient for the

results.claim: Three documents per iteration gave the best QA results on NQ, TriviaQA and HotpotQA; Auto-RAG beat Naive Gen and Standard RAG at every document count and fluctuated less than Standard RAG.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, 1-5 docs per iteration
results.quote: offering three documents per iteration yields superior results, indicating that

results.claim: Providing external knowledge first and parametric (self-generated) knowledge second beats the reverse order and external-only on average.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, order experiment, T=5 then TPK=5

results.claim: With parametric knowledge first, Auto-RAG stops after one iteration far more often on NQ (82.08% vs 44.65%) but is less accurate, suggesting fabricated self-generated knowledge.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, NQ iteration distribution, parametric-external order

results.claim: On a 1,000-per-dataset sample, Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B) averages higher than GPT-4o without retrieval; GPT-4o is worse with Standard RAG than without.

results.table: Table 6, row Auto-RAG Llama-3-8B-Instruct, column AVG

results.claim: A stronger base model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) lifts the average further.

results.claim: On PopQA long-tail subset (1,399 queries) with Self-RAG's original protocol, Auto-RAG beats Self-RAG.
results.setup: Auto-RAG (Llama-3-8B-Instruct fine-tuned on 10,000 synthesized instructions from NQ + 2Wiki), E5-base-v2 retriever, Wikipedia Dec 2018 dump, PopQA long-tail, answer-in-output accuracy

results.claim: Fine-tuning on synthetic data leaves general-task average roughly unchanged (slightly up).
